description: This file defines the 'Row' trait and companion object in Apache Spark SQL, including methods for constructing, accessing, and serializing rows of data, as well as handling JSON conversion.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Trait representing a row of data in Spark SQL, providing methods for data access, comparison, copying, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: unapplySeq
methods.description: Extracts fields from a Row object as a sequence, used in pattern matching.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructs a Row from given values.

methods.name: fromSeq
methods.description: Constructs a Row from a sequence of values.

methods.name: fromTuple
methods.description: Constructs a Row from a tuple.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges multiple rows into a single row (deprecated).

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty Row.

methods.name: size / length
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the Row.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema associated with the Row, if available.

methods.name: apply / get
methods.description: Accesses the value at a given index.

methods.name: isNullAt
methods.description: Checks if the value at a given index is null.

methods.name: getBoolean / getByte / getShort / getInt / getLong / getFloat / getDouble / getString / getDecimal / getGeometry / getGeography / getDate / getLocalDate / getTimestamp / getInstant
methods.description: Methods for retrieving primitive or specific typed values at a given index.

methods.name: getSeq
methods.description: Returns the array value at a given index as a Scala Seq.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns the array value as a Java List.

methods.name: getMap / getJavaMap
methods.description: Returns the map value at a given index as Scala Map or Java Map.

methods.name: getStruct
methods.description: Returns the struct value at a given index as a Row.

methods.name: getAs
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve value at index or by field name, with type casting.

methods.name: fieldIndex
methods.description: Returns index of a field by name (throws if schema is not defined).

methods.name: getValuesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of field names to values for specified fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the Row.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Row.

methods.name: anyNull
methods.description: Checks if any value in the Row is null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality comparison for Rows.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code implementation for Rows.

methods.name: toSeq
methods.description: Converts the Row to a Scala sequence.

methods.name: mkString
methods.description: Creates string representation of the Row elements with optional separators.

methods.name: getAnyValAs
methods.description: Utility for retrieving primitive values, throws if null.

methods.name: json / prettyJson
methods.description: Returns JSON string representation of the Row.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Generates JSON value for the Row based on schema.
